subject: Linguistics
title: Will We Always Write
description: One-minute skill: Will We Always Write.

hook.text: Voice assistants, dictation, and video calls are replacing typed text in daily life. Is writing dying?

buildup.text: Some predict that voice interfaces will make writing obsolete—others say writing will only adapt.

discovery.text: Writing offers what speech cannot: permanence, precision, editability, and silent communication.

twist.text: Texting is at an all-time high—writing hasn't declined; it's shifted from formal to informal channels.

climax.text: Writing has survived for 5,000 years through every technological revolution—clay to cloud.

punchline.text: Writing will evolve—but it won't disappear.

quiz.question: What advantage does writing have over speech?
